integrity: The proof uses the Euler-trail criterion and explicit degree-parity enumeration. Source comparisons were conducted at the level of scientific implications; possible unindexed equivalent formulations remain a limitation.
scientific_limitations: The exact rational generating function is ternary and length-two only; the general finite-alphabet theorem provides its leading asymptotic coefficient, not an exact all-alphabet rational generating function. All computational checks are finite corroboration, not substitutes for the proof.
title: Ternary length-two composition profiles and their finite-alphabet growth law
